pages.text: Beetles buzz around crops and help them grow. All but one kind are harmless.$(br2)One beetle in twenty is an $(item)omen$(), the only aggressive variant.

pages.name: Omen
pages.text: Common in mushroom fields. Aggressive, except toward gold wearers.

pages.name: Ladybug
pages.text: Sunflower plains, flower forests, cherry groves.
$(item)Potion gene$()$(br)An omen beetle can carry a potion effect. Its sting passes the effect on for a few seconds, and the beetle itself becomes immune to potion effects.

$(item)Breeding$()$(br)Most beetles like flowers. Omens like golden food and meat.$(br2)Two omens breed an omen, and any pair may, one time in a hundred, produce one.$(br2)If both parents share a gene, the child inherits it. Otherwise dose both parents with the same potion, and the child may take one of the effects they share.
